body:
Hi. Thanks for the contribution. I think the proposal needs more backing before we merge such a feature.

But my personal opinion on the matter is that this would be a really weird UX. Instead, I suggest to add a way to increase/decrease the brush size like most software do. I guess it should also be implemented in normal painting mode though, not only terrains.

Honestly, that's fair. This is a specific fix for a specific issue, and one that seems to affect a small subset of people, myself included. The main reasons I opted for this are:
- It mirrors behaviors seen in tools such as the Tiled map editor, which makes it far more intuitive for me and I'd assume others who've used Tiled. With this, I can use the in-engine tilemap tools in about the same way as how I'd use Tiled. Otherwise I either have to use a much less efficient workflow or just do all my editing with Tiled and use a plugin for imports. The latter is something I'm hesitant to do because I'd prefer to be able to design my tilemap with more awareness of the objects I'll place in it.
- Attempting to make this closer to a drawing tool makes the feature significantly larger. Not only does it need separate implementations between tile and terrain drawing, but it'd also need different shapes to be usable in that state. And while being able to use a circle-shaped paint tool in tilemaps could be useful, I'm not sure it's entirely worth the effort and extra complication.

I understand if more discussion and iteration needs to happen on this before it's able to be implemented. But I do believe something like this avoids over-complication and allows for a significant improvement of the tilemap workflow. That being said, if it's not implemented, I'll probably just be able to build my own version of stable releases with this feature implemented.
